scopeDescription: 43 Philippine NCCA periods/days; 57 country-jurisdiction entries expressly listed as holidays by EU EURES 2026
warnings: EURES is an EU institutional secondary index, NOT the country government's legal instrument
Fixed Gregorian recurrence excludes obvious Easter/mobile holidays and official 2026 observed substitute dates
Country-specific legal calendar entries can share holiday names with other countries; identities are jurisdiction-scoped
Five non-English display locales are English fallback, not human translations
No invented establishment years or reviewed long-form history

records.authority: Workplace Relations Commission — Ireland
records.subject: CULTURE
records.chronologyNote: Ireland introduced the permanent St Brigid's public holiday from 2023. The Workplace Relations Commission states the holiday is normally the first Monday of February, except when 1 February falls on a Friday, when that Friday is the public holiday. The traditional cultural commemoration on 1 February is a separate World Days record.
records.dateRationale: The national Irish Workplace Relations Commission establishes the movable February public-holiday rule. Authoritative overrides cover 2023–2100, including the Friday 1 February exception; later years fail closed pending recurrence expansion, never defaulting to a false fixed February 2 date.
